description: Autonomous-ATC provides a BlueSky fork with reinforcement-learning branches for autonomous air-traffic conflict-resolution research. The provider is Marc Brittain (marcbrittain). Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository supports research scenarios, not one geographic traffic dataset; the documented branches correspond to associated papers. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-3.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-bluesky, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
